transcript.answer: Otto was never built on Cloud Run in europe-north1. It deploys to the shared GKE cluster (`n8n-cluster`) in europe-west1 instead. The Cloud Run plan (#27) existed to put the service "in the same region as the Vertex model", which was meant to answer OLT's NIS-2 data-residency condition. That premise no longer holds. ADR-003 says that, measured on 2026-10-16, `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 models (pro, flash, flash-lite), and they retire on 2026-10-20. After that, no Gemini model on Vertex runs in `europe-north1`. The current models (3.x and 4) are served from the `eu` multi-region, which is the EU-resident option, so the model runs on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region. The sources I found don't say why GKE was picked over Cloud Run beyond this. PR #416 closed #27 as superseded, and ADR-003 replaced the unwritten `ADR-001-hosting-platform.md`. The Cloud Run requirements in the deployment spec (FR-032, CR-006, CR-011) are marked superseded.

judgements.reason: The answer states that on 2026-10-16 europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retired on 2026-10-20, that newer models are served only from the eu multi-region, and that Otto runs on GKE n8n-cluster in europe-west1, matching the gold answer.
